final_message:
All tests pass now. The fix was correct - the issue was that pytest was using an old cached version of the code from `build/lib/src/slugify.py` which had a bug where it didn't handle multiple consecutive non-alphanumeric characters properly (it used `[^a-z0-9]` instead of `[^a-z0-9]+`).

The fix I applied:
1. Changed the regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` to match sequences of non-alphanumeric characters
2. Added a second regex substitution to collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into one
3. Added `.strip("-")` at the end to remove leading/trailing hyphens

The tests now pass successfully.
